intro: HPE generation names roll out across different models over time. Gen11 began in 2022; early Gen12 AI systems were announced in 2024, followed by the broad Intel and AMD rollout in 2025. A later CPU or GPU refresh can keep the same server-generation name. Gen13 was announced in October 2026, with availability planned across late 2026 and 2027.

generations.label: Synergy family
generations.summary: Synergy was announced in December 2015. Later compute modules, including 480 Gen12, have their own generation dates.

generations.label: ProLiant Gen10
generations.summary: The Gen10 portfolio debuted in 2017, introducing the era of HPE silicon-based server security.

generations.label: Gen10 Plus · first AMD models
generations.summary: DL325 and DL385 Gen10 Plus appeared in November 2019. Other Gen10 Plus models followed, including a major 2021 wave.

generations.label: ProLiant Gen11
generations.summary: RL300 was announced in June; the broader Gen11 portfolio followed in November. Later CPU updates retained Gen11.

generations.label: Gen12 · early AI systems
generations.summary: HPE announced DL384 and DL380a Gen12 AI systems in June 2024, before the broader Gen12 rollout.

generations.label: Compute XD685
generations.summary: Announced in October 2024; general availability was planned for Q1 2025. XD uses model names rather than ProLiant Gen numbers.

generations.label: Gen12 · broad rollout
generations.summary: Eight Intel models were announced in February 2025; AMD DL325 and DL345 Gen12 joined in June.

generations.label: Compute XD690
generations.summary: Announced in June 2025 as an eight-GPU Blackwell Ultra system, with availability planned later that year.

generations.label: Gen13 · announced platforms
generations.summary: Announced 7 October 2026. DL525 planned for late 2026; DL585a and XD245 / XD285 for 2027. Announcement is not shipping confirmation.

generations.label: Cray XD675
generations.summary: Eight-MI300X system documented by July 2024; now retired. XD numbering is separate from ProLiant generation names.
